trace_schema:
CREATE TABLE milestone_plans (
                group_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                timestamp TEXT,
                status TEXT,
                schema_version INTEGER,
                milestone_count INTEGER,
                dependency_edges INTEGER,
                extension_count INTEGER,
                composition_count INTEGER,
                validation_attempts INTEGER,
                validation_failures TEXT,
                repository_topology TEXT
            )

CREATE TABLE runs (
                run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                timestamp TEXT,
                goal TEXT,
                duration_sec REAL,
                attempts INTEGER,
                status TEXT,
                files_modified TEXT,
                retrieved_chunks TEXT,
                active_skills TEXT,
                prompt_rendered TEXT,
                gate_outcomes TEXT,
                model_hops TEXT
            , failure_category TEXT, milestone_group_id TEXT, milestone_index INTEGER, milestone_total INTEGER, run_events TEXT, evidence_records TEXT, generation_metrics TEXT, failure_report TEXT, enforce_run_id TEXT)
